dossier_meta.catalog_title: Informal conjecture on the actual diameter
dossier_meta.statement_text: The bound (1.4) for the almost diameter is sharp and one may speculate whether the actual diameter is around the same length, i.e.\ $(2+o(1))\log 3V_\Gamma$.
dossier_meta.context_text: Having proved in Theorem 3 that for almost every $z\in\mathbb{H}$ one has $\min_{\gamma\in\Gamma}d(\gamma z,w)\leq(2+o(1))\log 3V_\Gamma$, the authors remark that this almost-diameter bound is sharp and speculate that the true diameter of the hyperbolic surface $\Gamma\backslash\mathbb{H}$ is of the same order. They note that this would imply the co-compact arithmetic lattice $\Gamma$ is generated by its elements of Frobenius norm $O_\varepsilon(V_\Gamma^{1+\varepsilon})$, bringing it into line with Theorem 1.
